findings.reason: a done-when unsatisfiable at its own head forces the worker to guess between an unstated migration and a hollow test, and either closes the node on a verdict that does not measure the work.
findings.text: clause (2) demands a test showing `Topology.read_qualification` and `ForwardFluxOperator._fixed_design_read` have no caller left outside `reduced_newton.py`, but at head `_fixed_design_read` is called from seven methods in forward_operator.py (`_connectivity_class_margin`:3100, `_carrier_shadow_read`:3165, `read`:3197, `_support_partition`:3339, `cell_current_moments`:3618, `residual_shadow_components`:3738–3742, `_frozen_topology_partition`:3787–3791) and `read_qualification` is called from `forward.py:2816` (and from `_fixed_design_read` itself, forward_operator.py:3015 and 3028), none of which clause (1) migrates (it names only the batched labeller); the test cannot pass at this node's head, so a worker either silently widens to a multi-module migration or writes an assertion that does not hold

findings.reason: the last-caller premise is what orders §6's deletion after §10; left uncorrected, §6 deletes a live read and breaks the production callers it says no longer exist.
findings.text: the sentence "the fixed-design read itself is therefore deleted in §6 with reduced_newton.py, its last caller", asserts a premise §6 relies on ("after §10 its only caller is reduced_newton.py"), but reduced_newton.py:2490 is one of nine call sites at head; §6 waits on §10 and §10 re-points only the batched labeller, so §6 would delete a read still called by `cell_current_moments`, `_support_partition` and `ForwardFluxOperator.read`. The same sentence's "called only by tests and one benchmark" also undercounts `Topology.read`, which three benchmarks call (traced_selection_seam.py:152, limiter_topology_receipts.py:118, pinned_branch_contrast.py:120)

response_events.note: §10 clause 2's test now asserts the satisfiable invariant: after the labeller migration, every caller of read_qualification and _fixed_design_read lies in reduced_newton.py, the solver and booking authority of forward_operator.py, or forward.py's solve route, which are exactly what §6 deletes or shrinks; no other module calls them.
